sloka: यज्ञ विघ्न करौ तौ ते न एव दास्यामि पुत्रकम् ।मारीचः च सुबाहुः च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ ॥१-२०-२६॥
transliteration: yajña vighna karau tau te na eva dāsyāmi putrakam ।mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca vīryavantau suśikṣitau ॥1-20-26॥

translations.english: Maricha and Subahu not only possess prowess but also are experienced in warfare. Together with my group of friends I can combat with one of the two".
